Archival Dispatch: 19 Master Broadcasts Dated Across AFRS Collection, Five Minute Mysteries, and The Story Lady

Date: 2026-08-21
Author: radio index
Reading: 4 min
Tags: AFRS, Harlem Hospitality Club, Frank Sinatra, Five Minute Mysteries, The Story Lady, Sleepy Hollow, Original Filenames
Raw Markdown

Batch 27 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 27 resolves 19 historic broadcasts: 7 wartime and post-war Armed Forces Radio Service (AFRS) master transcription discs (including Harlem Hospitality Club featuring Little Miss Cornshucks & Amanda Randolph, Frank Sinatra singing Night and Day, and Rebel Randall on Jukebox USA), 7 classic syndication episodes of the detective whodunit puzzle Five Minute Mysteries, and 5 storybook broadcasts from The Story Lady (including Washington Irving's Rip Van Winkle and The Legend of Sleepy Hollow).

1. AFRS Special Master Discs — 1944–1948 Military Transcriptions Dated

Preserved 16-inch lacquer and vinylite transcription discs:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate All-Star Talent
AFRS_0011_Harlem_Hospitality_Club.mp3 "AFRS Harlem Hospitality Club 11: Little Miss Cornshucks & Amanda Randolph" 1948-02-14 Legendary Savoy Ballroom broadcast celebrating Harlem blues and jazz artistry.
AFRS_GI_Jive_Harry_James.mp3 "AFRS GI Jive: Harry James and His Music Makers" 1944-09-04 Trumpet virtuoso Harry James headlines the AEF Jukebox of the Air.
AFRS_Basic_Music_Frank_Sinatra.mp3 "AFRS Basic Music Library: Frank Sinatra ('Night and Day' & 'Begin the Beguine')" 1945-06-18 Frank Sinatra's master vocal sessions for worldwide troop distribution.
AFRS_Jukebox_USA_Rebel_Randall.mp3 "AFRS Jukebox USA: Rebel Randall ('On the Sunny Side of the Street')" 1945-03-12 Hollywood glamour model Rebel Randall hosts swing requests for servicemen.
AFRS_Music_Views_Billy_May.mp3 "AFRS Music Views from Hollywood: Billy May" 1946-08-20 Composer and arranger Billy May showcases Hollywood studio orchestra talent.
AFRS_This_Is_The_Story.mp3 "AFRS This Is the Story: Anywhere Unlimited" 1947-11-10 Dramatic documentary anthology on post-war global reconstruction.
AFRS_Invitation_To_Learning.mp3 "AFRS Invitation to Learning: Classic Literature Discussion" 1946-05-19 Intellectual panel forum reviewing great works of world literature.
